```{r}
horizon <- 10
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(zoo)
library(tensorflow)
library(keras3)

tf$random$set_seed(1)
set.seed(1)
```

```{r}
infections <- read_excel("Data/Infections.xlsx")
infections$date <- as.Date(infections$date)

infections$day <- as.numeric(infections$date - as.Date("2019-11-30"))
infections$fog     <- as.factor(infections$fog)
infections$thunder <- as.factor(infections$thunder)
infections$dust    <- as.factor(infections$dust)
infections$smoke   <- as.factor(infections$smoke)

infections$estpos <- ifelse(
  infections$posencounters == 0,
  0,
  (infections$posencounters / infections$restests) * infections$encounters
)

lancet <- infections[, c(6, 4, 2, 20, 21, 32, 33)]

lancet <- lancet %>%
  arrange(day) %>%
  mutate(
    estpos = rollmean(estpos, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    maxtemp = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(maxtemp, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    precip  = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(precip,  k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    wind    = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(wind,    k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    pm10    = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(pm10,    k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    pm2.5   = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(pm2.5,   k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right")))
  )

lancet <- as.data.frame(na.omit(lancet))
```

```{r}
window <- 120
features <- ncol(lancet) - 1
target_col <- ncol(lancet)

samples <- nrow(lancet) - window - horizon + 1

x <- array(NA, dim = c(samples, window, features))
y <- matrix(NA, nrow = samples, ncol = horizon)

for (i in 1:samples) {
  x[i, , ] <- as.matrix(lancet[i:(i + window - 1), 1:features])
  y[i, ] <- lancet[(i + window):(i + window + horizon - 1), target_col]
}

test_window <- 10
train_end <- samples - test_window

x_train <- x[1:train_end, , ]
y_train <- y[1:train_end, ]

x_test  <- x[(train_end + 1):samples, , ]
y_test  <- y[(train_end + 1):samples, ]

x_train <- array(as.numeric(x_train), dim = dim(x_train))
x_test  <- array(as.numeric(x_test),  dim = dim(x_test))

y_train <- as.matrix(y_train)
y_test  <- as.matrix(y_test)
```

```{r}
model <- keras_model_sequential() %>%
  layer_lstm(units = 64, activation = "sigmoid", input_shape = c(window, features)) %>%
  layer_dropout(rate = 0.1) %>%
  layer_dense(units = horizon)
```

```{r}
model %>% compile(
  loss = "mean_squared_error",
  optimizer = optimizer_adam()
)

history <- model %>% fit(
  x_train, y_train,
  epochs = 100,
  batch_size = 5,
  validation_data = list(x_test, y_test)
)

plot(history)
```

```{r}
which.min(history$metrics$val_loss)
```

```{r}
model %>% evaluate(x_test, y_test)
```

```{r}
pred_train <- model %>% predict(x_train)
pred_test  <- model %>% predict(x_test)
```

```{r}
i <- 1

true_seq <- as.numeric(y_test[i, ])
pred_seq <- as.numeric(pred_test[i, ])

yr <- range(c(true_seq, pred_seq))

plot(true_seq, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
     ylim = yr,
     xlab = "Days Ahead", ylab = "Estimated Infections",
     main = paste0("LSTM ", horizon, "-Day Forecast (Test Window ", i, ")"))

lines(pred_seq, col = "red", lwd = 2)
```

```{r}
last_window_start <- samples - test_window + window
forecast_start_idx <- last_window_start
forecast_end_idx   <- last_window_start + horizon - 1

forecast_dates <- infections$date[forecast_start_idx:forecast_end_idx]

true_seq  <- as.numeric(y_test[nrow(y_test), ])
pred_seq  <- as.numeric(pred_test[nrow(pred_test), ])

yr <- range(c(true_seq, pred_seq), na.rm = TRUE)

plot(forecast_dates, true_seq, type = "l", col = "#1f77b4", lwd = 2,
     ylim = yr,
     xlab = "Date", ylab = "Estimated Infections",
     main = paste0("True vs Predicted ", horizon, "-Day Forecast (Last Window)"))

lines(forecast_dates, pred_seq, col = "#d62728", lwd = 2)

legend("topright", legend = c("True", "Predicted"),
       col = c("#1f77b4", "#d62728"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
```

```{r}
plot_lstm_kday <- function(
    k, pred_train, pred_test, lancet, infections, window, horizon, samples
) {
  
  if (k < 1 || k > horizon) {
    stop("k must be between 1 and horizon")
  }
  
  pred_k <- c(pred_train[, k], pred_test[, k])
  true_k <- lancet$estpos[(window + k):(window + k + samples - 1)]
  dates <- infections$date[(window + k):(window + k + samples - 1)]
  
  plot(dates, true_k, type = "l", col = "#1f77b4", lwd = 2,
       xlab = "Date", ylab = "Estimated Infections",
       main = paste0("True and Predicted Infections (LSTM ", k, "-Day Ahead)"))

  lines(dates, pred_k, col = "#d62728", lwd = 2)

  test_start <- nrow(pred_train) + 1
  test_end <- length(pred_k)
  
  usr <- par("usr")
  
  rect(xleft = dates[test_start], xright = dates[test_end],
       ybottom = usr[3], ytop = usr[4],
       col = rgb(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.25), border = NA)
  
  legend("topright", legend = c("True", "Predicted"),
         col = c("#1f77b4", "#d62728"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
}
```

```{r}
plot_lstm_kday(1, pred_train, pred_test, lancet, infections, window, horizon, samples)
```
